quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on team consistency and togetherness
quotes.excerpt: for this team to establish consistency there has to be that commitment to one another
quotes.quote: Something Coo said the other night, he just emphasized that for this team to establish consistency there has to be that commitment to one another on both ends. quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on Nate's defensive impact as a starter
quotes.excerpt: wanted to play a little bit bigger, I know I've got a couple of options
quotes.quote: Wanted to play a little bit bigger, I know I've got a couple of options to do that. This is his first start to get this type of matchup. He was on Reeves to start. I think he's going to build on this for sure. He's resilient, he's steady. He's been playing the right way on offense, been playing with force, been shooting the ball well. He just didn't get enough of the shots. Defensively, it's going to be a great challenge every single night.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins on Nate starting tonight: He is resilient and steady and will continue to build on this defensive challenge.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses Nate's performance and defensive assignment against Reeves in his first start.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on managing Usman's rotation minutes
quotes.excerpt: Usman's approach, he's been in our play groups out of the rotation
quotes.quote: Usman's approach, he's been in our play groups out of the rotation. I've challenged that group, or coaches have challenged those guys to stay ready. I think he's doing well, J-Rock's doing well, Gary's doing well. I'm sorting through all these things right now. He was doing some things defensively, some forceful plays on the offensive side, trying to find another guy that's got size that can maybe playmake so we're not always having our guards having to face all that pressure all the time.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says he is still sorting through rotation minutes to find more size and playmaking on the floor.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins addresses the rotation status of Usman and other players while looking for additional size and playmaking.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on addressing second-chance points
quotes.excerpt: the immediate fix is just a willingness to go hit more
quotes.quote: The immediate fix is just a willingness to go hit more. I think size is playing a role there for sure. Guys aren't always just coming down with it. I felt like in the New York game their bigs were coming down with a lot of them. Tonight there was more even tap-outs. We've got Jake LaRavia to his credit crashing, getting seven offensive rebounds, that's going to hurt you. We dive into the personnel, we show them the film, we just got a better commitment there. We got to be the first team to hit.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins says the fix for second chance points is a better commitment to hitting the glass and being the first team to hit.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses the team's need to improve rebounding and defensive commitment after facing New York.
